title: North Korea's Kim says country seeks security, not supremacy
summary: SEOUL, South Korea — Kim Jong Un said North Korea would strive to achieve “power and capability” to ensure its security and peace but would not pursue supremacy, state media reported…

blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea — Kim Jong Un said North Korea would strive to achieve “power and capability” to ensure its security and peace but would not pursue supremacy, state media reported Monday. Kim made the remarks at a ceremony to receive credentials from newly appointed ambassadors, including Russia’s, in a rare departure from protocol, as the task has traditionally been performed by a senior official rather than Kim himself. The ceremony followed Kim’s rejection of US President Donald Trump’s overtures last week during Trump’s visit to China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.
